description: This Java class 'Utils' provides utility methods for parsing date/time strings and handling regex matching, primarily used for processing logs or timestamps in bug reports.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class for parsing date/time strings and regex matching, mainly used in bug report processing.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the given text matches the provided regex matcher.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Returns the matcher if the text matches the regex, otherwise null.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer from a regex matcher group, or returns a default value if not present.

methods.name: parseCalendar
methods.description: Parses date/time components from a regex matcher into a GregorianCalendar object.
